method: Shipped engine + exact-UID runtime correction using game-capture evidence; realistic collisions and explicit counterplay, versus adaptation timing.

source.title: Ghost Babel — combat de Black Arts Viper (captures du jeu)
source.scope: Fils à hauteur du torse, évitables accroupi ; mines retardées visant une position stationnaire ; retrait après impact.

results.name: Only core__viper is corrected, preserving all 354 IDs and every other profile
Canonical repertoire has wire/mines and no gun or invented arm projectile
Runtime finisher corrections retain all IDs and other fighters while removing invented laser/gun families
Torso wire does not trigger during its visible arming delay
A standing target crossing an armed torso wire takes a real collision hit
Crouching passes below the wire without chip or stun
Standing guard blocks a frontal wire instead of taking the full collision
Moving opponent cannot produce a mine at an unobserved future position
A mine uses an already stationary position with 110 frames of warning
Leaving the announced position avoids the mine; it never tracks the target
Remaining in the announced position causes a delayed mine collision
Impact interrupts mine preparation before a device is created
A masked target is not used as a position oracle for mine spawning
Sprites do not alter authored hurtbox or melee reach geometry
